description: M5 control for slade at k=99999 (all labels), external-data replay settings (1000 epochs, patience 20). SLADE cannot run with an empty unlabeled pool (begin_unlabeled_pool raises 'requires at least two unlabeled samples' at fold setup), so this is the closest valid control: the unlabeled term at weight 0 exactly as make_phase2_ablations.ZERO_WEIGHT. At weight 0 SLADE attaches no basis and builds no pool, so the empty split pool is accepted and L_Basis is never computed. restart_selection_after_warmup is off for the reason given in configs/ablations/phase2/slade_zero_weight/slade.json: SLADE never reports steady state at weight 0, which would otherwise suspend early stopping for all 1000 epochs.
name: full_external_0_slade
